rows.en: (Hmm, what should I do with my day off tomorrow...?)

What has you looking so troubled,
\p?

Oh, Klan-senpai.
It's just, I still haven't decided
what to do with my day off tomorrow...
Have you already made plans, Klan-senpai?

Mm, of course I have.
Tomorrow I plan to go bug collecting for my research.

Bug collecting?
Wow, that's awfully childlike...
I told you, it's for my research!
S-Sorry...
rows.notes: Also used in nml_kln_013 and scd_com_104 (both genders).

rows.en: Honestly... What a rude one you are.

(Klan-senpai out collecting bugs...
She's definitely going to look like an elementary schooler.)
rows.notes: shotouka no ko: 'elementary schooler' as c07888 / c21261.

rows.en: (Hmm, what should I do with my day off tomorrow...?)

(Klan-senpai out collecting bugs...
She's definitely going to look like an elementary schooler.)

(Next class is P.E., huh...
I wonder what we're doing today?)

Oh, \p.
Do you have P.E. now?
I see... Well, good luck with that......
Huh? Why do you say that so gravely!?

Hilda-sensei had an enraptured smile on her face
earlier. When she smiles like that...

Whoops, the next class is about to start!
I have to get back to my classroom!
Ah! Klan-senpai!

(What kind of class is it going to be?
I've got a bad feeling...)

(Next class is P.E., huh...
I wonder what we're doing today?)

(What kind of class is it going to be?
I've got a bad feeling...)

(I came to Folmo today, and it really is
like something out of a fairy tale.)
Hm? If it isn't \p.

Oh, Klan-senpai!
Are you out shopping today?
Mm, I'm looking at clothes in Zentradi size.

Sorry, but I want to make the rounds
of all sorts of shops today,
so I'll be taking my leave.

(Macronized Klan-senpai looks so grown-up
and so different from usual,
it makes me a little nervous.)

(I came to Folmo today, and it really is
like something out of a fairy tale.)

(Macronized Klan-senpai looks so grown-up
and so different from usual,
it makes me a little nervous.)
(Let's see, my next class is...)

\p!
Have you seen Michel anywhere?
Huh? No, I haven't seen him.
I see, so he hasn't come this way...

Wait, why are you in a swimsuit,
Klan-senpai!?

Michel made fun of me in my swimsuit!
Michel shall not be forgiven!!

Just you wait, Michel!
I'll chase you to the ends of the earth!!

(Running around the school in a swimsuit
is going a bit far, though, Klan-senpai...)

(Oh, crap!
I forgot to do the homework for next class...)

What's with that helpless look,
\p?

Oh, Klan-senpai.
The truth is, I forgot to do my homework...

You fool! Forgetting your homework?
You lack the awareness a Mihoshi student
ought to have!

Still, you can't go into class like this.
Very well... I'll help you with your homework.
Huh! Are you sure?
Mind you, it's just this once.
Thank you, Klan-senpai!

(With Klan-senpai's help,
I somehow made it in time...)

(I'll have to thank Klan-senpai
properly next time.)

(Oh no!
I forgot to do the homework for next class...)

(I'll have to thank Klan-senpai
properly next time.)
(Okay, what should I have for lunch?)

\p,
are you going to lunch now too?
Yes, I was planning to...

I see. Then let's invite Michel and the others
and have lunch on the roof.
Oh, that sounds great. Let's do that.

Mm. Then let's buy some boxed lunches
and hurry up there.

(Eating together on the roof like this
isn't half bad.)

(Eating together on the roof like this
isn't half bad.)

(I never thought Gary-sensei's errand
would take this long...)

(I've got Michel and the others waiting
at the cafe, so I'd better hurry!)
\p, are you heading home now?

Oh, Klan-senpai.
Yes, I am.

Oh, sorry...
I've got Michel and the others waiting,
so I'll be going now.
Hm? You're meeting Michel now?

Yes, we'd planned to hang out, but something
came up for me alone... so I had them
go on ahead to the cafe.

I see...
Th-Then, may I come along too?
Sure, but do you have some business with Michel?

N-No!
I just suddenly felt like having
some of that cafe's coffee!
That's all it is, got it!

R-Right, of course...
Well, we can't keep them waiting any longer,
so let's hurry, Klan-senpai.
(Honestly... Klan-senpai is so stubborn.)

(I never thought Gary-sensei's errand
would take this long...)

(I've got Michel-kun and the others waiting
at the cafe, so I'd better hurry!)

Oh, sorry...
I've got Michel-kun and the others waiting,
so I'll be going now.

Yes, we'd planned to hang out, but something
came up for me alone... so I had them
go on ahead to the cafe.
Sure, but do you have some business with Michel-kun?
